steps.domain_action: the optical system is in its ground state, no light present
a coherent beam is generated and propagates toward the beam splitter
the beam splitter divides the incoming beam into two equal-amplitude branches, transmitted (T) and reflected (F)
the T-branch travels through the transmitted arm, accumulating a phase shift from the optical path length
the F-branch travels through the reflected arm, accumulating its own phase shift
the two branches recombine at the beam combiner; constructive interference on the output port recovers the original beam amplitude and phase
the recombined beam reaches the detector, closing the interferometer loop
the detector records the interference intensity as a permanent measurement
